headline.sentence: Verifying retrieved demonstrations before use was not shown to raise object precision (P_obj^VI) above post-hoc correction with the same verifier (PVR − A8 = -8.00 [-9.78, -6.34]) or above zero-shot captioning (PVR − A0 = 1.28 [-0.06, 2.64]).
